headline: Horrific Conditions in Some Alabama Daycares Will Finally Change With New Law
snippet: Child Care Safety Act signed. Watered down: ~500 centers continue without state oversight.

headline: The Daycare Bill, Part II: It's All About the Money
snippet: Republican leadership required working with wealthy churches opposed to the bill.

headline: Alabama House Committee Approves Faith-Based Daycare Regulation Bill
snippet: Unanimously approved after advocates named children injured/killed in exempt centers.
